key.name: resources-update-interval
key.summary: Seconds between readings while any page but Processes is shown

key.name: processes-update-interval
key.summary: Seconds between readings while Processes is shown

key.name: binary-units
key.description: When on, sizes are counted in 1024s and written as KiB, MiB and GiB; when off, in 1000s, as kB, MB and GB.

key.name: show-all-processes
key.summary: List the processes of every user
key.description: When off, only the processes of the user running Locus are listed.

key.name: process-arrangement
key.summary: How the list of processes is arranged
key.description: Apps lists the running apps first, each with its processes, then the other processes as trees. Tree lists every process under what started it. All lists every process on its own.
